=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:124-129 (AUTO_CLOSE_RE); call sites _pr_text 953-963, compose_description 1211-1233 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `AUTO_CLOSE_RE.sub("", ...)` strips in a single pass, so removing one match can join the leftover text into a new valid auto-close reference (e.g. "Fixes fix #1#2" becomes "Fixes #2", and "Fixes: fix #1#2" becomes "Fixes: #2").
  WHY: build_pr_body writes the stripped plan or model text into the maintenance PR body, and run_lint only refuses references to `ai:orchestrator-tracking` issues, so merging the PR auto-closes an ordinary issue #N; four reviewers rated it MAJOR (mapped to high) and gemini gave no severity, at confidence 2.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:132, 662-669 (PREFLIGHT_NOT_PASSED_RE in _semantic_errors) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The preflight deny-list fails open for common failure wordings: "not passed: 2 callers remain" and "did not pass" match no branch, and "2 callers found - FAILED" slips past the `^`-anchored branch, which has no re.MULTILINE.
  WHY: validate_result accepts a removal whose own preflight failed, then check_diff/run_apply commit the registry edit and delete the named script, which bypasses the "hard gate" between untrusted model text and a production-file delete.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:132, 662-669; finish_audit 743-747 (PREFLIGHT_NOT_PASSED_RE false positives) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The deny-list also fails closed on passing results: the "not ... run" branch matches anywhere (e.g. "passed: the job has not run since 2026-09", "passed: no workflow can run it (0 callers)"), and the anchored fail/error branch rejects "failure: none; 0 callers found".
  WHY: The audit ends as result_invalid with save_marker=false, so every idle poll tick re-runs the full 75-minute PLAN_AUDIT until main changes, the UTC day rolls over, or the wording changes; anthropic and z-ai rated it MAJOR inside a combined finding, while minimax and openai rated it NIT, so the highest is used.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:887-894 (check_diff archive target); prompts/mode-plan-audit.txt, prompts/_templates/mode-plan-audit.txt | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: check_diff refuses an `M` on an existing `docs/completed/<name>.md`, but neither the prompt nor validate_result warns about or checks the collision, so the model still archives as told and produces D plus M, which apply rejects as diff_outside_allowlist.
  WHY: The collision is a property of the repository, so every audit repeats the same refusal, saves no marker, and re-runs the 75-minute audit on each poll tick until the colliding file is renamed or removed.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:485-500 (run_collect), 1146-1164 (run_decisions) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When a collected trusted answer is neither applied (no `applied_decisions` entry) nor resolved, run_decisions still stores the comment count that already includes the answer and advances `asked_at` to `collected_at`.
  WHY: The next run_collect sees an unchanged count and skips the comments fetch; even when a later comment forces a fetch, trusted_answers drops the original answer as older than `asked_at`, so the answer is permanently lost and the `ai:plan-decision` issue is never closed (breaks Goal 7).
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:974-989 (build_pr_body status_issue / descoped gating) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: build_pr_body appends `Refs #{status_issue}` only when status_issue is truthy and `## De-scoped phases` only when descoped is nonempty; on a first run apply (orchestrate_poll.yml lines 2737-2744) runs before report (lines 2761-2763), so the status issue does not exist yet.
  WHY: A first-run or refresh-only maintenance PR body has neither `Refs #N` nor `## De-scoped phases`, and the lint does not check for their absence, so the PR is opened anyway.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Goal 5: "When the audit changed anything, one maintenance PR is opened from `ai/plan-autopilot-<YYYYMMDD>-<sha7>` with the step 9 commit split and PR-body contract (`Refs #N`, `## De-scoped phases`, never auto-close keywords, linted by `scripts/lint_pr_body_auto_close.py` before creation)."
  expected_change_site: scripts/plan_autopilot.py `build_pr_body` (line 962, `if status_issue:` at ~line 989), and the apply/report step ordering in .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The PR is opened in run_apply (step `Apply plan audit changes`), which runs before the report step that creates the first status issue, so the first-run maintenance PR body cannot link it. build_pr_body (lines 974-989) gates `Refs #{status_issue}` on `if status_issue:` and `## De-scoped phases` on `if descoped:`. orchestrate_poll.yml lines 2737-2763 run apply before report. "Never auto-close keywords" is enforced only by the single-pass regex strip plus run_lint. Nothing in the apply step or the workflow diff creates the status issue before the PR.
- requirement: Goal 10: "the status issue says so and nothing is started. The loop resumes on its own when main changes or a decision is answered."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml plan_autopilot_slot / plan_autopilot_seen key construction (lines 580-595), or the gate cache-key handling in scripts/plan_autopilot.py
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The cache key `plan-autopilot-v1-${PLAN_AUTOPILOT_SHA}-$(date -u +%Y%m%d)` only moves on a new default-branch commit or a UTC-day rollover, so an answered decision issue (or a new plan added without a main commit) is not picked up until then. Earlier rounds deferred this under §15 (Q5 A: "at most once per 24 h"), which contradicts the goal text.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:line 129 (AUTO_CLOSE_RE), and its single-pass uses `AUTO_CLOSE_RE.sub("", ...)` in _pr_text (line 959) and compose_description (lines 1217 and 1233) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The single-pass strip never rescans its own output, so removing a match can create a new reference: "Fixes Fixes #1 #2" becomes "Fixes  #2", "Fixes fix #1#2" becomes "Fixes #2", and "Fixes: fix #1#2" becomes "Fixes: #2". The URL form chains the same way.
  WHY: Plan, model and checkbox text reaches the PR body through _pr_text. run_lint only refuses references to tracking issues, so merging the PR closes #2. Suggested fix: a helper that repeats the substitution until the text stops changing (about 5 lines).
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:line 132 (PREFLIGHT_NOT_PASSED_RE), applied in _semantic_errors at line 668 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The deny-list misses failures ("not passed: 2 callers remain", "did not pass", "2 callers found - FAILED": the branch is anchored with `^` and has no re.M) and rejects passes ("passed: the job has not run since 2026-09", "passed: no workflow can run it (0 callers)").
  WHY: A missed fail lets validate_result and check_diff accept the registry removal and the script deletion. A false reject makes the result result_invalid with save_marker=false, so the 75-minute PLAN_AUDIT re-runs on every idle tick. Suggested fix: require each `result` to start with `passed`.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py, prompts/mode-plan-audit.txt, prompts/_templates/mode-plan-audit.txt:check_diff lines 887–894 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Only a new file (`A`) counts as an archive target, and an `M` on an existing `docs/completed/<name>.md` raises ApplyError("diff_outside_allowlist"). Neither the prompt ("write the same content to the new path and delete the old file") nor validate_result tells the model or checks this.
  WHY: The collision is a property of the repository, so every audit gets the same refusal, no marker is saved, and the 75-minute audit re-runs. Fix: add a prompt rule not to archive over an existing completed plan, and optionally reject it in validate_result.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:run_collect lines 494–500; run_decisions lines 1146–1160 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A collected answer that is neither applied nor re-listed in `needs_decision` is stored with the comment count that already includes it, and nothing records that the answer went unused.
  WHY: The next collect skips the comments fetch, the model never sees the answer again, and the `ai:plan-decision` issue is never closed (breaks Goal 7). Fix: keep the prior `comments` value (or set it to -1) for such paths.
- TASK COMPLETENESS / INTENT GAPS: NONE. Notes: the reviewer judged the PR-body gap (`Refs #N` / `## De-scoped phases` being conditional) not a gap, because `.claude/commands/audit-plans.md` (line 68) states the same conditions. It left out the Goal 10 gap as residual accepted under Q5 A.
- HARDENING: a repeat-until-stable `AUTO_CLOSE_RE.sub` helper at all three call sites (5 lines); require `re.match(r"\s*pass(ed)?\b", result, re.I)` for every preflight result (2 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:124 (AUTO_CLOSE_RE) | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: `AUTO_CLOSE_RE` with `re.sub` may not strip chained auto-close references written in an unconventional format (e.g. "Fixes fix #1#2").
  WHY: If the regex only matches "Fixes fix #1", the remaining "#2" may survive as a valid auto-close reference in the maintenance PR body and close an issue early on merge.
- scripts/plan_autopilot.py:668 (PREFLIGHT_NOT_PASSED_RE) | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The preflight validation regex is still open to phrasings that could let a failed preflight check pass as "passed".
  WHY: The apply step could delete a script on the strength of a failed preflight check.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "When the audit changed anything, one maintenance PR is opened ... with the ... PR-body contract (`Refs #N`, `## De-scoped phases`, never auto-close keywords, linted by `scripts/lint_pr_body_auto_close.py` before creation)."
  Expected change site: `scripts/plan_autopilot.py`, `build_pr_body` and the job execution order in `orchestrate_poll.yml`
  Evidence of absence: The PR is opened in `run_apply` (step `Apply plan audit changes`), which runs before the `report` step that creates the first status issue, so the first-run PR body cannot link it.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "The loop resumes on its own when main changes or a decision is answered." (Goal 10)
  Expected change site: `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml` (plan_autopilot_slot key) or the gate logic in `scripts/plan_autopilot.py`
  Evidence of absence: The cache key `plan-autopilot-v1-${PLAN_AUTOPILOT_SHA}-$(date -u +%Y%m%d)` ties a run to the SHA and UTC date, so an answered decision is not picked up until the next UTC day or main commit.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- HARDENING: scripts/plan_autopilot.py `run_apply` (line 1033): the `ls-remote` pre-check relies on network access; use a local `git show-ref refs/heads/<branch>` instead (3 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
